newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sundstrand raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sundstrand raised to buy.

text.p: -- Natwest Securities analyst Thomas Burns Jr said Friday he raised Sundstrand Corp to a buy from a hold, putting the stock on the recommended list.
-- Earlier, Sundstrand reported fourth quarter earnings before charges of $0.71 a share, up from $0.61.
-- Sundstrand also forecast that it expects 1997 earnings in a range of $2.65 to $2.85 a share, and sees sales growing by 10 to 15 percent.
-- Burns said Sundstrand's outlook for sales growth in 1997 is better than indicated earlier, with the improvement in its aerospace business.
